## Learning Objectives

At the end of this lecture, you will be able to:

- Set up Positron, Google Antigravity 2.0 and, if you wish, Claude Desktop
- Explain what a Quarto document and a GitHub repository are
- Describe the eight stages of the RREAAAPP workflow
- Explain what an AI assistant is and where it runs
- Use an AI assistant at each stage of RREAAAPP

## Today's Plan

| Part | Topic | You leave with |
|---|---|---|
| **1** | Set up your tools | Positron, Quarto, Antigravity, Git and GitHub ready to use |
| **2** | The RREAAAPP workflow | Eight stages to follow in every analysis |
| **3** | AI assistants | Which assistant to use, where, and how to use it safely |
